headings: (500 ML) CLEAN BLOSSOM HAND AND BODY CREAM

jsonld_raw.name: (500 ML) CLEAN BLOSSOM HAND AND BODY CREAM
jsonld_raw.description:
Scented hand and body cream. Presented in a container with a dispenser cap.

Clean Blossom | A luminous bouquet enhanced by a sophisticated woody signature. A cheerful scent featuring three precious white flowers celebrating faceted beauty. Wraparound jasmine heart note glows with the vibrant citrus tones of orange blossom and the sensual exoticism of vanilla flower.

Notes:
Top notes: petitgrain, tangerine, pine cone, bergamot.
Heart notes: orange blossom, spicy lavender, jasmine and vanilla flower.
Base notes: vanilla, tonka bean, vetiver, ambrox.
